paragraphs.source_en: Asahi-hime took the cup. Before she had even seen the man’s face clearly, she had already become his wife! Once more, the face of her dead husband appeared in the cup. A dreadful foreboding seized her: she had swallowed Saji Hyūga-no-kami, and henceforth he would dwell forever in her heart, ready at any moment to drive her to assassination…

paragraphs.source_en: Whatever their personal circumstances or feelings, for the common people the marriage of the pitiable Asahi-hime and Ieyasu was nevertheless a victory. Was Ieyasu aware of that?
